    2 module Kernel
    3   private

    5   # Used to check whether method arguments are of a given class or respond to a method.
    6   # @param value_pairs [Hash{Object => Class, Array<Class>, Symbol}] value pairs to validate
    7   # @example Validate a class or method
    8   #   validate foo => Integer, baz => :to_s # raises an error if foo is not an Integer or if baz doesn't implement #to_s
    9   # @example Validate a class from an array
   10   #   validate foo => [Sprite, Bitmap, Viewport] # raises an error if foo isn't a Sprite, Bitmap or Viewport
   11   # @raise [ArgumentError] if validation fails
   12   def validate(value_pairs)
   13     unless value_pairs.is_a?(Hash)
   14       raise ArgumentError, "Non-hash argument #{value_pairs.inspect} passed into validate."
   15     end
   16     errors = value_pairs.map do |value, condition|
   17       if condition.is_a?(Array)
   18         unless condition.any? { |klass| value.is_a?(klass) }
   19           next "Expected #{value.inspect} to be one of #{condition.inspect}, but got #{value.class.name}."
   20         end
   21       elsif condition.is_a?(Symbol)
   22         next "Expected #{value.inspect} to respond to #{condition}." unless value.respond_to?(condition)
   23       elsif !value.is_a?(condition)
   24         next "Expected #{value.inspect} to be a #{condition.name}, but got #{value.class.name}."
   25       end
   26     end
   27     errors.compact!
   28     return if errors.empty?
   29     raise ArgumentError, "Invalid argument passed to method.\r\n" + errors.join("\r\n")
   30   end
   31 end
